tested_on: ASUS RT-AX92U (main router and three AiMesh nodes) and an RT-AX56U node running stock ASUSWRT, the maintainer's network: every read was run against them; all five routers returned processor, memory and temperature, four returned the uptime, and four had a firmware update waiting
reviews.notes: Written with the assistant Claude. New: more read-only requests per sync (a login per router and the router's own status pages). The nodes accept the main router's login. Reviewed, not yet confirmed by the maintainer.

tested_on: ASUS RT-AX92U running stock ASUSWRT (the maintainer's router): the per-device application read was run against it (26 applications for the busiest device)
reviews.notes: Written with the assistant Claude. New in this version: one extra read-only page request per busy device, and it obeys Netlens' own switch for application statistics. Reviewed, not yet confirmed by the maintainer.

tested_on: ASUS RT-AX92U running stock ASUSWRT (the maintainer's router): the new Traffic Analyzer reads were run against it and returned 45 applications and 24 devices for the day
reviews.notes: Written with the assistant Claude. The new part is read-only (two extra page reads per day and a clock read); the AiMesh part is unchanged from 1.1.0. Reviewed, not yet confirmed by the maintainer.
